title: Named routing overrides a single-display user choice on side 2 and runs with Auto detect off
source: Introduced by 3858ae1; fixed in f877ee3 with a test that a single-display choice keeps every side.

expected.what: For side 2, chosen is only lower_explicit_, which select_single clears, so on a single-display profile that names side 2 the user's explicit texture choice is overwritten by the named texture.

The panel-name pass in discover_pfds runs unconditionally, although automatic selection below it is gated on Auto detect, so named textures are adopted while the user has turned automatic selection off.

evidence: The side-2 test misses explicit single-display selections, and the A340-600 profile in the same change names all three sides. The fix uses the same chosen test for every side and gates the naming pass on Auto detect.
